name: Braid
description: Pairs of bars crossing over and under by turns, plaiting the grid into a running braid.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8%; top: 34%; width: 84%; height: 30%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); ${round} -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 34%; top: 8%; width: 30%; height: 84%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); ${round} -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @even { :before { z-index: 2; } } @odd { :after { z-index: 2; } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
